title: Monicity of restriction on an ideal twist
statement: Let $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $I$ an ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Suppose $I(U)\cap\ker(i)(U)=0$ on every open $U$ of $Y$. Let $M$ be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], $m\ge0$, $N=M^{\otimes m}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and let $\eta$ be the unit of the chosen module tensor-pullback adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $\mu:I\otimes N\to N$ for multiplication. Then $\operatorname{im}(\mu)\hookrightarrow N\xrightarrow{\eta_N}i_*i^*N$ is a monomorphism of module sheaves.

source.place: Remark remark-conductor, final sentence, and the local trivialization argument used in Lemma lemma-dim-1-noetherian-reduced-separated-has-ample

proof.text: For maps a:T -> I.toModules and b:T -> J.toModules with equal composites into O_Y, evaluate on every open U. The common value lies in both ideals by range_toModulesι_app_eq_idealOfOpens, hence is zero by hzero U. Extensionality makes the composite zero, and canceling the monic ideal inclusion gives a=0.

Set N=M.tensorPow m. N is invertible, and tensorRight N is an equivalence with inverse tensorRight N.dual. For maps a and b into I tensor N and J tensor N having equal composites, precompose with the counit isomorphism at their source and take functor preimages. Faithfulness gives equal untensored composites. Step 1 makes the preimage of a zero; mapping back and canceling the counit gives a=0. Tensoring the monic ideal inclusions preserves monicity, and so do the unitor composites.

Apply closedImmersion_unit_kernel to N for the same Classical.choice adjunction used in the statement. Any g:T -> image(mu_I) with g followed by image.ι(mu_I) and the unit zero lifts through image.ι(mu_J) by the limiting kernel fork. Since both multiplication maps are monic, imageMonoIsoSource identifies their images with I tensor N and J tensor N. The lifted equality, after cancellation of the common unitor, is the equality in step 2. It forces the map into I tensor N to be zero; cancel its image isomorphism to obtain g=0. Preadditive.mono_iff_cancel_zero proves the required monomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Remark 09NW, I/(I intersection J), and Lemma 09NX; implemented by tensor equivalence and the existing unit-kernel theorem (Modules 08KS), group F4.

theorem closedImmersion_disjointIdeal_twist_mono {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hzero : ∀ U : Y.Opens, I.idealOfOpens U ⊓ i.ker.idealOfOpens U = ⊥)
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (m : ℕ) :
    let adj := Classical.choice (nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)
    let μ := I.toModulesι ▷ M.tensorPow m ≫ (λ_ (M.tensorPow m)).hom
    Mono (image.ι μ ≫ adj.unit.app (M.tensorPow m))
